n: CodeHS Social Studies with micro:bit unit
t: A CodeHS micro:bit unit where students program a 13 colonies map and a timeline.
steps: Get a CodeHS license through the Get in Touch link on the course page.
Buy micro:bit boards and USB cables.
Read the Coding with BBC micro:bit overview.
Test a board with a Chromebook through MakeCode.
Review the privacy terms of CodeHS and Microsoft MakeCode.
